name: Dorei Shima -Slave Island-
source:
AngelBlack's latest work is a story of humiliation and defilement that unfolds on an island once known as "Slave Island," where lilies scatter!

Saginomiya Girls' Academy, one of Japan's leading academies, was established by the Saginomiya family, one of the five major zaibatsu (financial conglomerates) that secretly control Japan, with the aim of cultivating independent, world-class women in science and engineering. It conducts advanced and extensive scientific education and research.

Saginomiya Arika, a third-year student in the research club, is a direct descendant of the Saginomiya family.

Arika, a genius who skipped a year of the school's general research club, was also arrogant due to her family background and talent, reigning as the queen of the school. Furthermore, she possessed a sexually twisted sadistic inclination, using the power of the Saginomiya family to forcibly control students she targeted, subjecting them to sexual torture and conditioning in her dorm room, treating them as pets.

That spring, a young girl enrolled in the research club as a scholarship student.

Hana Brandis.

Her blonde hair and youthful appearance, resembling that of a middle school student, were enough to stimulate Arika's sadistic desires.

Arika tried to take advantage of Hana's vulnerability as a scholarship student to possess her.

However, looking back, it was from this point that the gears of Arika's fate, which had previously been lived as she pleased, began to turn drastically…

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110916022645/http://angelblack.jp/doreijima1.html]official website[/url]]
